title: Console Publication
description: One operator's mark that a thread may be read outside the node. This is the authoritative record the outward surface is derived from; contracts/public-projection.schema.json renders it and never decides it. Withdrawal appends a lifecycle entry rather than deleting the mark, so the history of what was public and for how long stays reconstructable - a projection can stop rendering a thread, and nothing can claim it was never rendered (decisions/0039).

node_id.description: The node publishing the thread. A console refuses to publish a thread belonging to another node; that would be republishing a peer's record under this node's name.

visibility.description: The one visibility this record grants. The enum has a single member on purpose: a thread is either marked for the outward surface or has no publication record at all. Degrees of visibility would be an access-control system, and this node's access control is grants.

published_by.description: The operator who marked the thread public, under a live grant with capability publish scoped to the thread. Publishing is an outward effect and stays attributable to whoever caused it.

withdrawn_at.description: When publication was withdrawn; null while the thread is still published. Present together with lifecycle WITHDRAWN.
